_doc: Training loops for Map 0 (agent_bonus: added to the player bot's loop score, BotTrainer.loop_score, T-071; a negative one keeps it off a loop that is bad to train on alone) (Update 03 section 3, T-056; gravelight/bots/training_route.gd). points: the loop's control points [x, y, z] in order (closed: the last joins the first), smoothed by `smooth` Chaikin passes and resampled every 0.5 m. ring_width: the open space the loop runs in (m, wall to wall across the line). requires_doors / requires_zones: door ids / zone ids (GameState.open_zones) that must all be open before bots use it. home: a squad with no human leading it makes its home on the open route with the highest home (T-058; 0 / missing = never). Validate: gravelight/tools_src/route_tool.tscn -- --map=map00 --validate (also run by smoke_bot_loco).

routes.label: round the taproom tables
routes.notes: Clockwise round the middle tables east of the bar (the soak dummy's loop). Tight on purpose (MAPS.md): Map 0 is about holding.

routes.label: the taproom-to-stable loop
routes.notes: The taproom loop with the stable spliced in: through the kitchen back door, down the yard passage, round the stable's east half and back up the passage (a lollipop: the inn and the stable only meet at that door).
routes._agent_doc: A lollipop: the yard passage is walked both ways, so the agent (T-071) avoids it.

routes.label: the stable's east half
routes.notes: A ring in the stable's open east half, the hay stairs on its west side (the navmesh has no way round the stairs' north end: the stalls and the space under the landing block it), like the soak dummy's stable stretch.

routes.label: round the yard (the Well Loop)
routes.notes: T-071: the Carters' Yard's open middle, round the well and the crate spot (x 5.5-25.5, z 37.5-45): 2-3 m inside the fences and clear of the woodpile and the cart. The longest open loop on Map 0 and the agent's favourite once the stable and the yard are open (agent_bonus): the four fence gaps feed it from the sides, so cut-ins are the thing to watch.

routes.label: round the barrel stack
routes.notes: The Old Cellar's barrel vault (T-051): round the central stack, between it and the two pillars. Corridors 4.9 (W) / 3.2 (N, S) / 4.4 m (E).

_high_ground_doc: High ground (T-058, TrainingRoute.high_ground_for): spots a precision shooter (Wren: personality combat.high_ground) fights from when the fight is within watch_m of the spot and the squad is near. pos on the navmesh; requires_doors as for routes.

high_ground.notes: The stable's hayloft edge over the east half (the stable loop), up the hay stairs.
The loft's north end, over the tack room and the yard door.
